sentences.display: One story told of a Bedouin, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Qilāba, who, while searching for his lost camels in the time of the caliph Muʿāwiya, came upon a great city with walls and gates.
sentences.tts: One story told of a Bedouin, Abdullah ibn Qilaaba, who, while searching for his lost camels in the time of the caliph Mu-aawiya, came upon a great city with walls and gates.

sentences.display: When others went back with him to the place, they found nothing.
sentences.tts: When others went back with him to the place, they found nothing.
